LanguageData.TotW_KeyHint: {0}: switch between light and heavy. Shift + {0}: turn off. (Change the key under Options, Keyboard.)
LanguageData.TotW_ShowEvents_Desc: New letters appear as // TODO comments and messages as // NOTE comments, coloured like in the game.
LanguageData.TotW_ShowLogErrors_Desc: New errors and warnings from the debug log appear as compiler errors (red) and warnings (yellow).
LanguageData.TotW_ShowAlerts_Desc: Alerts in the bottom-right corner (starvation, idle colonist and so on) are logged when they appear and when they are resolved.
LanguageData.TotW_ShowPawnStates_Desc: Logs when a colonist is downed or gets back up, has a mental break or recovers, is drafted or undrafted, or gets a new injury or illness.
LanguageData.TotW_ShowJobs_Desc: Logs every time a colonist starts a new job. Busy with many colonists.
LanguageData.TotW_ShowSummary_Desc: Every in-game hour, logs colonist count, average mood, days of food and wealth for the current map.
LanguageData.TotW_LogOnly_Desc: Shows only the game events and status lines above, without the scrolling code.
LanguageData.TotW_DisguiseWindow_Desc: While the overlay is on, the window title and icon change to the title below and the Notepad icon (title bar, Alt+Tab and the taskbar). Both are restored when the overlay turns off. If RimWorld is pinned to the taskbar, the taskbar keeps the RimWorld icon.
LanguageData.TotW_RandomPauses: Random pauses in the fake code
LanguageData.TotW_RandomPauses_Desc: The fake code stops for a few seconds now and then, like a build waiting on something. Game events still show up right away.
